mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause hyperglycemia and may reduce insulin effectiveness, while also increasing renal risk in diabetic patients with potential for acute kidney injury affecting both drug clearance and glucose control.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely during amikacin therapy; adjust insulin dosing as needed and ensure adequate hydration; assess renal function regularly given aminoglycoside nephrotoxicity risk in diabetic patients.
